name: Closed thin-section armband at the distal arm + 2R donut pointer with a lateral spar
verdict: DEAD at GATE 0 by a parameter-free anatomical bound: no rigid closed ring about any GH axis (humerus axis or tilted <= 16 deg, s 240-300, any bore <= 112 mm, section >= 8 mm) exists on more than 0.567 of clip frames / 0.706 of the workspace (medial arm on the flank at rest, walking-like frames, IR at the side, across-low; the flexed forearm near the elbow) -> gap >= 57.7 on Bench(60,160) (per-pose ring 51.9; Bench(110,360) exact humerus axis >= 67.0) vs the 15 / 17.5 bar and the lead 18.49. Faithful kit model best honest 212.62 (score 22.68, k15; 17 configs; 0 passive translations, complexity 0.5).
note: Bench(60,160) fast, K3 march, K2 dense, K6, ring outer cylinder + side annuli contact-checked; best honest k15 (J1 bvec(30,70), sigma -1, 90/90, KA055XP0 at s 260 on the humerus axis, spar c +40, q 0.9): gap 212.62 reach 0.581 follow 0.367 ib14 0.146 ib10 0.098 contact 0.47 (87 poses ring outer face in the body); k11 200.43 (A1 110 / A2 70) flagged sparse (hub 2 parked > 250 mm out) - not the claim. GATE (17 configs): 2nd-half gain 7.19, last-third gain 5.80, top-5 spread 7.19 - not converged; the verdict rests on the bound (ring_bound2 in the model: 35 cells, every ring parameter at its best), which no further search can beat. Frozen exact Bench(110,360) wear of the model not run (pointless at 212); the bound was re-measured there instead (humerus axis s 240-280: >= 67.0-74.1). Spec fixes: J1 at the acromion top (seat rule), O20 hubs, fold margin 5 in th, bore 69.85 (KA045XP0's 57.15 is inside the triceps). Forwarded from the J1 ring scan (169-204/220 contact) - agrees.
limiter: (1) anatomy: a closed loop round the upper arm must pass between the medial arm and the flank, which touch on 19-27 % of poses (rest, rest+IR, across-low) - follow <= 0.567, reach <= 0.706 for any ring; near the elbow (s 300) the flexed forearm fills the ring plane (reach 0); (2) the humerus axis is eccentric in the arm (2-mm-clear radius 58-74 posterior vs 34-46 medial) - a ring that holds the arm floats >= 20 mm off the medial skin (ring in band 0.11); (3) the 90/90 pointer's hub 2 sits on the great circle 90 deg from J1 (neck / trunk): 0.00 in band in all 17 configs; (4) the twist-free spar clears the arm at every axial angle: 0.00-0.06 in band. Kinematics are fine: th 78-174, min margin 6.37, closure 1.0.

mechanism.notes: bodies: link 1, link 2 (strap + spar + ring stator housing, one bolted part), ring rotor housing (bolted into the user's cuff). joints: J1, J2 O20 hubs (MR117 pairs), J3 = one Kaydon Reali-Slim KA..XP0 4-point thin-section ring. custom: base, link 1, link 2 strap, spar, stator housing, rotor housing, 2 hub shafts; catalogue: 4 x MR117, 1 ring. Complexity 0.5 (tools/simplicity.py v2.2).

bound.method: ring_bound2: annulus skin-free on 36 rays and the humerus line through the ring

auditor.reproduced: k15 re-run through the model file: gap 212.62, reach 0.5813, follow 0.3667, ib14 0.1458, ib10 0.0983, contact 0.47, outer-face contact 87 poses - identical to the claim
auditor.gate: sweep NOT converged (17 configs: best gain over the 2nd half 7.19 score points, over the last third 0.00 by the k-order split [the claim's 5.80 used another split], top-5 spread 7.19); farm closed, no CMA run - the death rests on ring bounds that cover every ring parameter, not on the sweep
auditor.bounds: the claim's 57.7 is OPTIMISTIC for the design (a pose with no ring is simply dropped). A closed ring cannot vanish: no stops -> every such pose is contact too: >= 90.9 at the best cell (contact >= 0.332). Generous stops (J1/J2 excluding ANY cap of arm directions, 600 axes x 5-120 deg, plus a twist window): >= 72.2 at the best cell (8 deg posterolateral, s 280, face 72; best stop = a 35-deg cap about the adducted arm-down direction; contact still 0.145), 74.7-84.5 at the other cells - all with every other part ideal (in-band 0.90). Proximal stations the claim did not bound with a tilt: s 200 / 220 at 8 deg posterolateral 83.1 / 72.9, s 220 8 deg lateral 66.2 (perfect stops) - worse, the claim's coverage gap closes
auditor.why_not_within_10: to reach gap <= 78.93 the rest of the metal may cost <= 6.7 points over the 72.2 ring-only stop-aware floor, i.e. in-band >= ~0.83 with no hub / link contact; the twist-free link 2 (spar + strap, pointing frame over a 58-74 posterior / 34-46 medial arm section) measured 0.00-0.37 in band in all 17 configs and the circular ring face 0.20-0.23 at the best cells
issues: convergence gate not met; accepted only because the ring bound covers station, tilt, bore and section
claim's bound treats ring-less poses as dropped without contact (design-favourable); honest no-stop 90.9, generous stop-aware 72.2

the ring's skin face is modelled circular; an arm-fixed rotor housing could be contoured to the arm (ring in-band 0.11 -> ~0.9) - unexplored but cannot close the gap (ring-only floor 72.2 + twist-free link 2)
median skin distance 31.8 mm reported for hub2 / link2a / spar is the fast cache clamp (+31.75), not a measurement
frozen exact Bench(110,360) wear of the model not run (bound re-measured there instead; acceptable at 212)
auditor.verdict: DEATH STANDS: no closed rigid ring about any GH axis fits between the medial arm and the flank / the folded forearm on >= 43 % of clip frames and >= 29 % of the workspace; even with ideal stops and every other part ideal the gap is >= 72.2 (no stops >= 90.9) vs the 17.5 gate and the lead's 18.49
